content_sections.heading: GACL Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the GACL Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download GACL Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: GACL Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A vacancies are available for Head (Strategy & Business Excellence) and Engineer / Assistant Engineer (Civil).

content_sections.heading: GACL Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: B.E / B.Tech (Chemical / Mechanical / Industrial / any disciplines) preferably with MBA Candidates must have completed B.E / B.Tech (Civil) full time from a government-recognized university.

content_sections.heading: GACL Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The candidate should not be above the age of 55 for Head Maximum Age Limit: 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 13-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of GACL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GACL Engineer / Assistant Engineer (Civil) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application is 13 September 2026. Ensure you apply well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the required educational qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a full-time B.E / B.Tech degree in Civil Engineering from a government-recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for the GACL recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Engineer / Assistant Engineer (Civil) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the GACL Engineer / Assistant Engineer (Civil) positions?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official GACL website or by using the direct application link provided in the "Important Links" section.

faq.question: Q6. When does the online application process start?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 12 September 2025.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Full Time.

faq.question: Q8. Does GACL provide salary details in the notification?
faq.answer: Salary details are not explicitly mentioned in the provided data. It is advisable to check the official notification for specific salary information.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any specific vacancy numbers mentioned for the Engineer / Assistant Engineer (Civil) post?
faq.answer: The provided data indicates 0 total vacancies for the Engineer / Assistant Engineer (Civil) post.

faq.question: Q10. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online.
